**Streetnut Eyewear One-Year Warranty Policy**

**Coverage period:**
1 year from the date of purchase, with proof of purchase. Streetnut offers a one-year limited warranty on its eyewear. The warranty applies only to the original buyer and cannot be transferred to anyone else. This policy applies to eyewear bought on or after 1 January 2026.

**What does the warranty cover?**
This warranty covers defects in materials or workmanship on frames and lenses bought from streetnut.com or in our [stores](/chapters).

**What does this warranty not cover?**
Issues caused by: (i) commercial use, (ii) normal wear and tear (including scratches), or (iii) misuse, accidents, neglect, alterations, improper repairs or improper storage. Any of these will void your warranty.

**How do I start a warranty claim?**
Email [warranty@streetnut.com](mailto:warranty@streetnut.com) with a short description of the item, proof of purchase (your order confirmation or store receipt) and photos of the defect. Our team will reply within 5 business days.
